name: Trigger Finger / Stenosing Flexor Tenosynovitis
definition: Painful catching, clicking or locking of a flexor tendon at the A1 pulley, commonly affecting thumb, ring or middle finger.

typical: Locking in flexion in more advanced cases

redFlags.item: Irreducible locked digit with severe pain

investigations.MRI: Ultrasound may help in atypical cases.
investigations.radiographs: Routine radiographs are not needed unless joint/bone disease is suspected.

green: Activity modification and short-term splinting in selected cases
amber: Corticosteroid injection or surgical release is considered for persistent or severe locking.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli/Snayu Vata phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Painful catching, clicking or locking of a flexor tendon at the A1 pulley, commonly affecting thumb, ring or middle finger.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
